Commentary.Commentary: After that, a couple of brilliant cameos from Shenwari and Shafiqullah gave the hosts the push they needed. The Bangladeshi bowlers tried hard but leaked too many runs towards the fag end for their liking. It is a pretty competitive score on a surface which is on the slower side. Bangladesh have to bat well to hunt this one down. Join us shortly.

The momentum is with the home side and they have finished on a high. 71 from the last 5 overs is a result that they will be really happy with. It was a sensible start from the hosts as the opening pair of Shahzad and Ghani laid the foundation with a 62-run stand. However, the visitors pulled things back with some quick wickets. A double-wicket over from Mahmudullah jolted Afghanistan somewhat.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes out to bat, but Rashid Khan will be facing the final delivery of the innings as the batsmen crossed.

SIX! Just the finish the hosts needed, 19 from the final over. Pitched up ball outside off, Rashid Khan hangs back, kneels and hammers it over wide long off for a maximum. AFGHANISTAN FINISH ON 167/8.
OUT! Janat holes out in the deep! Length ball outside off, the batsman goes for a wild slog but mistimes it towards cow corner. Mosaddek Hossain in the deep runs to his right and takes a fine catch.

OUT! Bingo, another one goes down! Tries the slower ball but it is way outside off. The batsmen try to steal a run but the keeper is aware of the situation. Underarms a throw to find Stanikzai short of his crease.
Karim Janat strides out to bat with just two balls to go.
Outside off, Rashid Khan goes for an agricultural slog but misses it completely.
Rashid Khan walks out to bat. He needs to smash from the word go...
OUT! Timber! Low full toss on off, Shafiqullah swings with all his might but is foxed by the lack of pace on it. Gets beaten and finds his off stump dislodged. A brilliant knock from him nonetheless.
SIX! This guy is playing a gem of a knock. He is on 24 from 7 balls. Off pace ball on a full length outside off, the batsman clears his front leg and slogs it over mid-wicket to find the fence.
SIX! Hit with authority! Slower ball on a shortish length, Shafiqullah goes deep in his crease and pulls it with aplomb. Has hit it very well and it is in the deep mid-wicket stands.
Abul Hasan will bowl the final over of the innings. Can he finish well? Or will the Afghan pair take him to the cleaners?
Ooh! That must hurt! Shafiqullah drills this one back towards Hossain who takes a blow on his foot. He is down and looks in pain. Hopefully, he will be alright. Hossain ends with figures of 4-0-32-1.
Banged in hard on the deck, Shafiq goes for the hook shot but misses.

FOUR! In the gap! Bisects the field to perfection. Full length ball, tailing in. The batsman knows what he is doing. Hits it with power between long on and deep mid-wicket and gets the desired result.
Leg bye! Back of a length ball, Asghar throws his bat but the ball hits his back leg and rolls to the off side. The batsmen steal a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.

SIX! Whoaaa! That is some confidence. Walking into the bat and smashing out the leather of the ball. Full ball on middle and leg, Shafiqullah clears his front leg and tonks it over cow corner for a massive maximum.
Shafiqullah Shafiq strides out to bat.

OUT! A brilliant cameo from Shenwari ends! Slower delivery on a short length outside off, Shenwari pulls it but doesn't get enough power behind it. This time Hossain at deep mid-wicket doesn't make any mistake. He runs to his right and is cool as a cucumber to pouch it.

SIX! Runs are coming thick and fast now. Short ball, Shenwari takes it on but ends up getting a top edge. It is in the gap at deep backward square leg though and seems to have gone over the boundary. Well, the replays confirm so.

FOUR! That is shoddy stuff. Back of a length ball on middle and leg,  Shenwari swipes it across the line. Mosaddek Hossain at deep mid-wicket runs to his right, puts in a casual effort but makes a mess of it to concede a boundary.
Short ball outside off, Samiullah slashes at it but misses.
FOUR! 10 from 2 balls, this is what the hosts need. In the slot outside off, the batsman swings hard and hits it like a tracer bullet over the the bowler. Clean as a whistle.
SIX! What a shot! That is out of here. Widish delivery outside off, Shenwari crouches and smashes it over covers. It is going, going and easily clears the man in the deep.
Abu Jayed returns for a bowl.
Outside off, chipped over covers for a run. 10 from the over.
Similar ball, Asghar slogs it away on the bounce to deep mid-wicket. A run taken.
Fullish ball, tailing in, jammed with the angle to long on to rotate strike.

In the air... but safe! Short ball, climbing on the batsman. He goes for the big pull across the line but only manages a top edge. The ball goes up and falls in the vacant mid-wicket region. Two runs taken.

Dropped and Four! On a length on off, Shenwari lifts it towards long on. Mahmudullah runs to his left, leaps and gets a hand to it but the ball bursts through his hands to reach the ropes. The fielder is signaling a boundary but the umpire wants to check it upstairs. It has just bounced inside.
Brilliant yorker on middle, Stanikzai is up to the task and jams it towards mid on. A single taken.
Rubel Hossain comes to bowl the 17th over.
Outside off, cut away to backward point.
Just missed the off pole! Quicker one outside off, coming in with the angle. Shenwari tries to cut it but misses.

SIX! Boom! That came right off the screws. Tossed up ball around off, sits up nicely for Shenwari. He kneels, lines it up and nails the slog sweep over mid-wicket. The connection is really good and the ball sails into the stands.
Floated ball, knocked down to long on for a run.
Shorter in length, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan comes back into the attack.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Spinning away sharply, Shenwari tries to dab it but gets it from the outer half of the bat towards short third man.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Tossed up ball, driven to mid off for a single/
Shorter ball, defended off the back foot.
Stays in the crease and tucks it to the on side to rotate strike.
The batsman works it down the leg side. Two runs added to the total.
Islam is back on.
On middle and leg, tucked to the leg side. What an over from Mahmudullah, two wickets and a run from the over.
Samiullah Shenwari is the next man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Double blow in this over for the hosts. Nabi goes for a duck. Mahmudullah bowls a drifter from around the wicket and it carries it on with the angle. Nabi tries to play it through covers but misses. There is a gap between bat and pad and the ball crashes into the stumps.
Floated ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. They pick up a single.

OUT! This has been a good passage of play for the visitors. This was a poor shot from Zadran. He comes down the track but is not quite to the pitch of this delivery. Tries to turn it to the leg side but only manages a leading edge towards Jayed at short third man who takes it safely.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.

Slog sweep from Stanikzai but he fails to make contact with the ball and gets rapped on the pads. Another loud appeal for leg before, but the umpire is unmoved. Impact once again was outside the off stump line.
Eases this one in the gap on the off side. They take a quick single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Leg Bye! Huge shout from the Bangladesh fielders but turned down by the umpire. Stanikzai goes right across his stumps to heave that but misses and gets hit on the pads. Impact is outside off. They take a leg bye.
Fires it full on the stumps, the batsman drills it to long off. Single taken.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Najibullah Zadran is the new man in.

OUT! The Bangladesh skipper has delivered! Shahzad makes room and Shakib smartly bowls it outside off. The batsman goes for a reverse sweep but only manages to play it uppishly towards backward point. Mahmudullah stationed there takes it safely.
The batsman drives this through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short ball, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.

Dropped! Not an easy one though. Tossed up ball, Shahzad skips down the track and tries to hammer it down the ground but only manages to hit it from the bottom half of his bat. The ball goes towards Shakib who dives, gets a hand to it but fails to hold on. A run taken.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads and picks up a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Driven towards the mid-off region. One run added to the total.

SIX! The batsman has lofted that over mid wicket, high and handsome over the boundary ropes for a maximum. The Afghan skipper gets into the act now. The umpire raises his arms in the air to signal a six.
The ball has taken the inside edge of the bat and goes down the leg side.
Once again, he flicks it to deep mid-wicket and gets a single.
Bowls it slower through the air, Asghar works it gently to the vacant mid-wicket region. He calls for two straightaway, the bowler hares after the ball but fails to prevent the second run.
Brings his wrists into play as he punches it to long on for a single.
Pushes it to the mid-wicket region for a single.
Touch short and Shahzad powers it to long on. Single taken.
Shahzad backs away to punch that, but ends up getting a thick inside edge past the keeper. The ball rolls to fine leg and they take two.
Nazmul Islam comes to bowl his third over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman just manages to keep the yorker out. Good ball bowled by the bowler. One run added to the total.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Asghar Stanikzai walks out to bat.

OUT! Gone! Leg stump goes for a walk. Rubel strikes and breaks the 62-run opening stand. Ghani decides to break the shackles with a big hit, dances down the track and looks to go big and plays across the line, but he misses it altogether and the ball smashes into the leg pole. Sends it cartwheeling towards the keeper. This is a timely wicket for the visitors. These two openers were threatening to take the game away from them in the first 10 overs.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Rubel Hossain is back into the attack.
Stays right back in his crease and forces it to long on for a single. Ghani moves to 25, he needs to improve his strike rate which is just over 100 at the moment.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Slower, shortish delivery outside off, Shahzad flat-bats it to long on for a single.
Good length ball, Ghani works it to the left of long on for a single.
Too full from Jayed and Shahzad smothers it to long off for a single.
Opens the bat face and chops it to third man for a single.
Abu Jayed is back into the attack.
FOUR! Boom! Shahzad hammers it over the bowler. Tries the slower ball and Shahzad is quick to pick that. The ball races to long off fence in no time.

No ball! That is criminal, Hasan oversteps and that's a no ball. Full ball on the pads and Ghani flicks it to deep square leg for a single. 50 up for Afghanistan. Free Hit coming up, Shahzad will be on strike for it...
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Slapped, can't give room to this man, he says thank you very much and slaps it powerfully away to the point boundary. A poor delivery from Hasan and it got the treatment.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Shahzad was shaping for a big shot but changes his mind after seeing it outside off. Sits back and cuts it to backward point.
Slower ball on the stumps, Shahzad defends it on the leg side.
Abul Hasan comes for a bowl.

Reaches out for a wide delivery and dabs it to short third man. Straight to the fielder and that's another dot. End of the Powerplay and it has belonged to Afghanistan, they have scored 44 without losing a wicket.
Backs away to punch that, but the ball goes off the inner half down the track.
Gently works it on the leg side and takes a quick single. Shakib tries to prevent it but fails.
Charges down the track and blocks it on the off side. Shahzad wanted a run but his partner sends him back, and rightly so!
Shahzad looks to flick that one but he misses it and wears it on the pads.
Taps it on the leg side and they take a single.

FOUR! Brute force from Shahzad. This time he stays back in his crease and powers it through the covers, the fielder in the deep had no chance of stopping it. 15 from the over, just the kind of over Afghanistan needed.
FOUR! Smashed it! Shahzad bangs one straight back over the bowler for a boundary. Goes down to the pitch of it and blasts it to long off for a boundary.
Darts on middle and off, the batsman backs away and pushes it down the track.
Tucks it off his pads to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BANG! Tossed up delivery on off, Usman Ghani takes a step out and clouts it high over the long on fence for half a dozen.
Ghani goes hard at that one, the ball goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Nazmul Islam is back into the attack, change of ends for him.
Plays it firmly down the ground to long off. Just four singles off the over, terrific start from the skipper of Bangladesh.
Nudges it to mid-wicket, just the single added to score.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Stays in his crease and dabs it on to the off side.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Shakib Al Hasan comes into the attack.
Shahzad charges down the track and pushes it to mid off. They take a quick single.
Whacks it firmly but only to find the man at mid-wicket.
Sits on the back foot and runs it down to third man for a single.
Four Leg Byes! Wrong line from Rubel and that's four more added to the total. Drifts it down the leg side, the ball kisses the pad and races away to fine leg fence.
Stays in the crease and defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Brilliant shot, Ghani gets a half volley on the leg stump line and he dismisses it past the man at mid-wicket for a boundary.
Rubel Hossain comes into the attack.
Flatter ball, Ghani uses the depth of the crease and punches to deep mid-wicket. Single taken. Excellent over from Islam, just four runs from it.
Dances down the track and plays a drive to long off. Another single added to the total.
Uses his wrists and works it to the right of the mid on fielder for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Dabs it on the leg side and calls for a quick single. Good running between wickets from the Afghan openers.
Stays in the crease and pushes it to the cover region.
Nazmul Islam comes to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Ghani ends the over with a strong flick, places it right between the fielders at mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary. 9 runs from the opening over, a good one for Afghanistan.
Stays on the back foot and defends it solidly.
Pulls, but the ball comes to him quickly than he expected. Mishits it wide of his partner. They steal a quick single.
Sits on the back foot and gently pushes it to the mid off region.
FOUR! Whipped away in fine style! Jayed bowls an overpitched delivery on middle and leg stump line. Shahzad brings his bottom hand into play as he whacks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shahzad is not happy with the sightscreen.
Good length ball outside off, Shahzad plays away from the body and mistimes the square cut on to the off side.
We are all set to go... Mohammad Shahzad and Usman Ghani are out, the former will take the strike. For Bangladesh, Abu Jayed will bowl the first over, there is a slip in place  for him.
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and opt to BOWL first.

Bangladesh, the visiting team in this series, will start as the underdogs. However, they would be desperate to rub that off pretty quickly. They are sitting two positions below their opponent in the ICC sheet of T20Is but rankings are often misleading. The tourists are tall on experience and they would be hoping for major contributions from their big-match-players. Both the teams would be wanting to start on a winning note. A scintillating contest awaits us. Do stay tuned as we bring you the toss and the teams.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the 1st T20I of the three-match series between Afghanistan and Bangladesh. The former team has taken giant strides towards their goal in last 12 months. They earned a Test status, won the World Cup Qualifiers and here they are playing their first bilateral series against the side led by Shakib Al Hasan. Afghan players did well in the Indian T20 League, Rashid Khan in particular was exceptional with the ball and his performance will play a major role in the fate of the home team.
